edits_applied.before: Everything in this piece rests on one source: the official Journals of the Continental Congress, volume 25 — the order of audience agreed on December 22, the audience of the twenty-third, and the text of the address. No private account by anyone present was consulted, and so the speaker's face and tone, and the reactions in the room, are simply absent. Motives, private thoughts, and options he may have considered are never supplied by this writer where the source is silent.
